metadata.description: Skills and agents for Talentech: company-wide core, design, product and research plugins, plus an opt-in developer plugin.

plugins.name: talentech-dev
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills with Mimas's setup and review skills, plus tiered worker agents and a /orchestrate-spec orchestrator.

plugins.name: talentech-core
plugins.description: Company-wide skills for every department: the grilling interview that role plugins wrap, grill-me and questionnaires, plus publishing to and pulling from Confluence (which needs the Atlassian connector).

plugins.name: talentech-design
plugins.description: Skills for Product Design: design briefs, design readiness, FigJam flows, a UX-flow grilling interview, wireframes, handoff pages for builders, Talentech UX content and translation.

plugins.name: talentech-product
plugins.description: Skills for Product Management: grill-prd takes a product idea from raw problem to a developer-ready PRD in two gated stages, on top of talentech-core's grilling; business-case interviews a PM and writes a comparable business case (case card, case page and, for large initiatives, a management deck).

plugins.name: talentech-research
plugins.description: UX research skills for design and product: research plans, method choice, interview guides, surveys, mixed methods, affinity synthesis, insight extraction, business cases, ethics and share-outs.
